traceability.notes: The 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX story is fully implemented for its intended scope. Auto-fix of missing @story annotations on functions and methods is provided via the require-story-annotation rule and its helpers, using a conservative placeholder template and ESLint’s fix API. Safe, suffix-only normalization of @story paths is implemented in valid-annotation-format with guarded fix logic that only operates when a safe, pattern-compliant transformation is available. Dedicated tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts, along with broader rule tests, validate the before/after behavior and confirm that fixes are applied consistently and predictably while preserving code formatting. Documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md accurately describes these auto-fix capabilities and clearly notes that configurable templates and selective toggles are future enhancements, matching the story’s own requirements section. All relevant tests pass under Jest, so this story’s functional requirements and acceptance criteria are satisfied in the current codebase.
